svg.text: Figure 3-5 · SW FMEA structure and function tree
SWF rev 0.9 · BL-005 · draft · AIAG-VDA steps 2–3: structure elements by level, functions of each element
RX validation and RX timing checks
Validate safety-relevant RX messages (checksum, counter, quality flag, timing)
Transmit only whitelisted messages, each passed through the mode-specific check
Block stock-camera messages the item replaces; forward all others, including stock pre-collision messages
Allow controls on rising edge of PCM cruise; withdraw on cruise off, brake press, invalid or lagging safety messages
Block steering requests outside torque magnitude, rate and measured-torque-error limits, and any torque while controls are not
Block acceleration outside the range, and any non-inactive acceleration while controls are not allowed or the accelerator is
Decode Toyota vehicle state: EPS torque, cruise state, brake, accelerator, wheel speeds
Detect a relay malfunction and block all item transmission
Install only the safety model and parameter intended for the vehicle
Panda main loop: safety mode and
Withdraw controls when the host heartbeat is lost or reports not engaged
Accept host configuration commands only when they cannot widen what is transmitted
Route every host transmission through the safety check
Reset the MCU, which releases the relay, within 0.1 s when the safety task or main loop stops; never reset while both run
Send the heartbeat at 10 Hz. It reports engaged only while the SoC is engaged and actively commanding, so that the panda can
withdraw authority when the host stops (supports FSR-005 and FSR-007, which are allocated to EL-07)
Put the panda in the safety model, parameter and alternative experience for the identified vehicle, only when onroad, and in
NO_OUTPUT when offroad, with ignition off or on exit
Forward each sendcan batch to the panda once, in order, only while it is fresh, and make any failure to forward visible to the SoC
CAN RX and panda state publishing
Publish received CAN and the panda state (mode, parameter, controlsAllowed, RX-check validity, faults) correctly and on time, so
the SoC can detect a mismatch or fault and disable
Transfer commands and data between SoC and panda without undetected corruption. Detect link failure in bounded time and
Run pandad only against the intended panda firmware. Recover a panda in DFU or bootstub without disturbing an active drive
Engage only on an ENABLE event with no NO_ENTRY event active
Go to disabled in the same cycle on USER_DISABLE or IMMEDIATE_DISABLE, and within SOFT_DISABLE_TIME on a persisting
Enter overriding while the driver steers and yield lateral control
Raise fault and driver-action events from carState, pandaStates and process/message supervision, including controlsMismatch
when the panda safety model, parameter or controls-allowed disagrees
Detect PCM cruise active while not engaged and warn the driver
Raise the forward collision warning only from fresh and valid modelV2 and longitudinalPlan inputs (TSR-625)
Give each event the reaction type (no entry, soft or immediate disable, user disable) and alert its fault requires
Present the most urgent alert; every takeover request visual and audible
Detect excessive longitudinal or lateral vehicle response while engaged and soft-disable
Publish selfdriveState (enabled, active, alert) every 10 ms cycle, consistent with the state machine
controlsd main loop, input handling and
Request lateral control only while selfdriveState is active, no EPS fault is reported and the car is above the minimum steer
speed; request longitudinal control only while enabled and not overridden
Compute actuation only from fresh, valid and finite inputs (selfdriveState, modelV2, longitudinalPlan, vehicleParameters,
lateralTorqueParameters, deviceMotion), and stop actuating otherwise
Request PCM cruise cancel whenever PCM cruise is engaged and the item is not enabled
Command deceleration that traffic does not require (driver-monitoring no-response, soft-disable force deceleration) only after it
has been announced, and keep it announced while it lasts (TSR-624)
Generate a steering torque request that tracks the limited desired curvature within the envelope and yields while the driver steers
Generate an acceleration request within the range and rate envelope from the longitudinal plan
Limit desired curvature to the lateral acceleration, lateral jerk and curvature bounds
Apply torque magnitude, rate and measured-torque limits; send zero torque with the request bit cleared when lateral control is not
active; send the ACC command within the acceleration range
Send the inactive acceleration in ACC_CONTROL whenever longitudinal control is not active
Deliver every 10 ms control step to the vehicle, and stop sending item frames when carControl is no longer received
Toyota port, CAN parse and pack)
Provide brakePressed, gasPressed, steeringTorque/steeringPressed, cruise state, vEgo and EPS fault from current vehicle CAN,
and report invalid or missing data as canValid false within the RX budget
Identify the reference vehicle and produce its CarParams (TOYOTA_COROLLA_TSS2, safety parameter 73, openpilot longitudinal)
Pack actuation and HUD frames with the commanded values, the correct scaling, counter and checksum
card main loop and stock AEB interlock
Run the car interface every CAN cycle, publish carState, and actuate only the latest carControl
Estimate face, eye and attention state of the driver for every cabin camera frame
Escalate an inattentive or unresponsive driver within the policy times (vision 5/8/13 s, wheel-touch 5/15/25 s) and request the
Plan an acceleration within the envelope that keeps the following distance to a lead and stops for a stopped lead
Raise a forward collision warning when a collision with the lead is predicted
Provide the lead state (distance, relative speed and acceleration) from radar tracks matched to model leads, and flag radar faults
failure modes analyzed for the function
